contested_decisions.description: Diego Costa pushed his hand into Nabil Bentaleb's face; referee Taylor judged it accidental and took no action, angering Spurs. Bentaleb later said Costa could have been sent off.
contested_decisions.assessed_by: no expert assessment found; journalist/player comments only (TheFA report; Bentaleb quoted via HITC)
contested_decisions.impact_reasoning: At 0-0; a red card would have left Chelsea with ten men for over an hour in a match won 2-0.

contested_decisions.description: Eric Dier (already booked at 31') took out Costa right on half-time; Sports Mole commentary said he could have received a second yellow.
contested_decisions.assessed_by: no expert assessment found; journalist comments only (Sports Mole live commentary)
contested_decisions.impact_reasoning: At around 0-0/1-0 with the whole second half to play; Chelsea won anyway, so in practice it did not change the outcome against Chelsea.
